theorems.name: Submission.continuous_integral_comp_blowUpMap
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → Continuous (fun x : Euclid P => ∫ y, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
